programme.desc: 悅遇上同學「油脂玲」志玲，身為警察的她在悅滿面前捉拿悍匪。玲捉賊之事被電視廣泛報導，但悅滿面不屑，更認為自己於求學時以風紀身份教育她，令她有此成就。悅感人生沒起伏，想起是因朋向她求婚才令她放棄考警察。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#2粵普PG
programme.desc: 郭靖看不慣完顏康欺負穆家父女，出手教訓，卻不是他對手，幸得王處一相助。王處一中了毒砂掌，所需藥材卻早已被人買光。郭靖與黃蓉河邊相見，看她一身女裝才知她身分。二人夜闖王府找藥材，發現穆家父女被關在牢中。

programme.title: 食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽教你用一種平價蔬菜取代薄荷葉，炮製豬膶蛋花湯，還透露令煲湯豬膶特別爽腍秘方。「大蝦炒鮮奶」煮法容易，處理金華火腿、蝦仁和鮮奶各有竅門。肥媽還教你用近百元的大墨魚，煮出過千元的花膠口感。

programme.title: 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《用心‧家的中秋味道》由星級藝員傅嘉莉、關嘉敏、關楓馨、姚焯菲、黃奕斌、謝雪心參與演出。節目藉着一家四姐妹跟月餅相關的工作、學習與生活日常，帶出連鎖餅店用心製作、研發不同口味、款式的月餅，務求讓顧客能夠透過這種中秋慶節食品，感受家的味道。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肝癌早期病徵不明顯，確診時多已屬中晚期。外科醫生詳析手術治療肝癌的考量因素；而新近的無創組織碎化術準確度更高，也有助減低對其他器官的傷害。社福機構調查顯示，約每十二位中學生就有一人存在學校隱性疏離的風險，常見表現包括獨處、無故缺課等，都是學生輟學前的關鍵訊號，需及早介入支援。機構代表與社工細談學校、家人可怎樣提供相關協助，主持黃劍文亦自言曾面對類似問題。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨示範「青蔥油涼拌鮑魚」。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 遊茂名必吃海鮮，「好玩隊」帶薛家燕逛魚市場，買馬鮫魚蛋做手信；「夠歎隊」則安排酒店級海鮮餐，黃椒醬蒸蟶子、「蠔炸」好惹味。好心湖呈藍、綠色，團隊踩單車遊湖畔，唱聚大草地兼野餐，皆大歡喜！街頭美食滿載風味，到牛雜一條街嚐牛心頂等少見部位，再往夜市試試臭豆腐、燒豬腦。下一站，「援兵」徐榮、阮浩棕入隊玩轉陽江。汽車服務區成網紅熱點，還可盡情買手信？享用傳統農家菜後輕鬆耍樂，酒店「游乾水」最合家燕姐心意。

programme.title: 東坡家事#18粵
programme.desc: 少游因討得皇上歡心而升官。月娥使計成為一扇軒唯一老闆，大妹一無所有。月娥知道假懷孕後要季常休掉大妹，季常拒絕並與大妹離開陳府。皇上假扮書僮要東坡帶他見琴操。季常遭賊匪打劫，衣服被搶，被途人誤會行乞……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子在雜誌上看見百貨公司懸紅尋找槌之子，正好小玉在學校說自己看到槌之子被質疑，兩人加上丸尾一起尋找槌之子，並計劃用獎金成立末玉桃槌之子股份有限公司，將來享受榮華富貴、窮奢極侈。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 藉着兔仔跳、弓箭步等動作充份熱身後，兒童體適能教練Ban Sir引領大家鍛練下肢的爆發力。除了做出原地跳、左右跳的動作外，還會安排兩人一組，利用阻力帶進行訓練，小朋友在家亦可邀請爸媽一同參與，增添互動樂趣。稍作休息後繼續「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，核心訓練需要利用氣球作輔助工具，重點是加強腰腹肌群力量，動作是怎樣的？另外，本集還會播放AI生成動畫《濫竽充數》的下半部。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 小源終於拍攝她第一道甜品烹飪片。正當大家享受茶會之際，烹飪偶像佐藤楓突然闖入攝影廠，把小源帶到外面。出於興趣相近，小楓對小源很有興趣，還說起她對愛麗絲比亞的感情。然而就在這時，多蘭再次現身。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 2003年，政府三十幾年來第一次實施隔離令，將淘大花園E座居民隔離，其後更宣布將所有E座居民全部搬去度假營，新聞掏寶和大家重溫2003年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐卓越理財呈獻:卓越滙談粵
programme.desc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2867粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 敢威因某海峽遭封鎖，蒙受極大損失。Ceci主動借錢助他解困，敢威以20%接龍股權作抵押。另一方面，力蓮等人決定不收分文放棄各自的接龍股權，與敢威互不相欠，雙方鬧得不歡而散。其後，眾人分別遇上麻煩，Ceci告知是敢威所為，她還出手幫助各人。Ceci認為敢威太過份，提出讓他改過之法，提議眾人將股份出讓給她，眾人察覺有詐而拒絕，詎料……接龍再次變天，力蓮想到替敢威取回一半話事權的方法，但必須作出犧牲……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#4粵PG
programme.desc: 珠寶廣告構思外洩，原來是家謙兄長葉啟榮的陰謀。幸如憶起夢裡家謙因此被迫辭職，繼威漁人得利因而升職；升職後的繼威隨即向幸如求婚，成為夢中不幸人生的起點。幸如設法協助家謙，不讓夢境成真，終與家謙一同構思出新的廣告主題。家謙成功化解危機，與幸如關係出現進展。熙妍推敲出幸如能「預知未來」，更為此質問她，幸如只好坦白「預知夢」一事。幸如與公司其他女生結為好友，被冷落的雪文心有不甘，決定出手將幸如搶回來……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 前列腺癌是本港男性第三大癌症殺手，且有年輕化趨勢。這集改編自真實案例的患者是職業貨車司機，他原以為腰痠背痛只是工作勞損，怎料求醫後確診前列腺癌第四期。泌尿外科教授吳志輝指出，多肉少菜、高脂飲食都可能是病因，也澄清忍尿、飲水不足並不會誘發前列腺癌。吳教授進一步介紹局部定位治療與前列腺癌的微創手術，都有助減少病人在手術過程中的創傷；調查科也會向中醫教授了解如何協助患者術後調理，以及日常飲食的注意事項。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#9粵普
programme.desc: 紀封著手查帳，財務部送去幾車亂帳，給他個下馬威。一直帶頭對抗蜜語的小佳被客人投訴偷竊，蜜語不計前嫌解決事件，保住了小佳，並藉此事恩威並施，贏得人心。本已辭職的薛睿不忍紀封孤軍作戰，決定重返浦榮支援他。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
再創世紀#17粵PG
programme.desc: 麗瞳動議撤換主席，天生率先支持，讓定垚看清其真面目。投票之際，啟堂突然出現。思妤收到太陽花以為是高哲所送，沒想到是追求者。定垚得知父親心臟病發真相，報警求助。程凱再次從小慧身上得到靈感，決定研發智能家居，成功獲得董事注資。令翹向明晞推銷自己，明晞要她查探學禮有何動作。明晞估計學禮想參與能源項目，天生決定插手分一杯羹。天生宣布出讓傲堂股份，啟堂私下詢問高哲會否跟自己爭奪。定垚驚悉內地發展部集體辭職…

programme.title: 東坡家事#19粵PG
programme.desc: 大妹和季常在閏之的酒樓幫忙，月娥氣憤。皇上否決安石興建烽火台建議。東坡帶琴操到春釀坊做禡；席上蘇轍批評皇上，說話傳到皇上耳中被責廷杖調職。淑眉懷疑琴操告密，東坡極力維護。淑眉擔心史密聽到自己的秘密……

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐對於農夫介紹何遠東、胡鴻鈞兩位嘉賓出場的笑話，搖頭大表失望，卻見農夫一臉「得戚」？原來在保加利亞，點頭與搖頭有相反意思！台灣「問題專員」欣賞店舖內的藝術畫，又大歎咖啡，究竟店內賣甚麼？泰國的超大型餐廳可容納五千位食客，連菜式亦大有名堂，一道「堅離地冬蔭公」因何得名？日本湯料販賣機供應的樽裝調味湯料，內裡又有甚麼特別？今集竟有嘉賓答題捧蛋收場，幸得Do姐大發慈悲送分，方可參與兌換貨幣遊戲……

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐請來麥美恩、周奕瑋上演精彩對壘。適當使用酒具能增添飲酒時的樂趣；韓國一款像手榴彈般的新奇產品，有何作用？兩位嘉賓信心十足，同時利用雙倍錦囊先拔頭籌，更得Do姐大讚叻叻！法國里昂大街突兀地出現一格紅色地磚？美國亞利桑那一間洞穴酒店，竟建議住客「朝十晚四」離開房間，如不遵從會發生甚麼事？看過貼士的C君試圖用謊話擾亂敵隊，卻被陸永一眼看穿……今集兌換貨幣環節又刷新紀錄！

高朋滿座#158粵
programme.desc: 悅要考輔警，高家為此分成支持與反對兩派。根提議以「兵捉賊」的遊戲來打賭，要悅扮警方，在二十四小時內捉拿由根扮成的恐佈分子，眾家人則配合雙方。追查過程中，悅處處碰璧，要家人多番提示才能繼續遊戲。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 完顏康騙包惜弱說穆家父女已走，郭靖取藥被大蛇襲擊，為保命吸光蛇血後，去救穆家父女得悉穆易是楊鐵心，包惜弱來放人卻沒認出眼前人。黃蓉偷聽完顏洪烈等人對話被發現，憑機智化解，包惜弱向完顏洪烈問起當年之事。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽教煮母親節「大茶飯」，請來狄易達、鄧佩儀、吳業坤、楊斯雅、容天佑作客。川貝清熱潤肺，加入海底椰、豬腱等用健康湯水孝敬母親。「栗子燜米鴨」六號都煮到，還有包糠羊架、蒜子浸黃魚、合掌瓜素雞炒雲耳。

programme.desc: 《用心‧家的中秋味道》由星級藝員傅嘉莉、關嘉敏、關楓馨、姚焯菲、黃奕斌、謝雪心參與演出。節目藉着一家四姐妹跟月餅相關的工作、學習與生活日常，帶出連鎖餅店用心製作、研發不同口味、款式的月餅，務求讓顧客能夠透過這種中秋慶節食品，感受家的味道。

programme.title: 滙豐卓越理財呈獻:卓越滙談粵
programme.desc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「馬拉色菌」是皮膚表面的一種共生真菌，過多或會引發毛囊炎、汗斑、脂溢性皮炎，專科醫生細說相關資訊，並提供治療方法。此外，如何從日常習慣減少馬拉色菌的滋生？言語治療師列出嬰幼兒口腔肌肉發展的四個主要階段，有何先天、後天因素會導致口腔肌肉發展障礙？家長切忌過份照顧嬰幼兒，留意可從孩子的進食、語言表現察覺相關問題；治療師亦會帶來改善建議。「睇餸食飯」，Annie炮製「肉醬意粉」，上桌前撒芝士碎就更吸引。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 下榻陽春溫泉度假酒店，兩隊會師網紅水道玩水戰。享用房內私家溫泉，再歎春砂仁宴，讓家燕姐由外到內養生進補！公路服務區竟有直送海鮮餐，為疲倦旅途注入動力。從豆豉探尋陽江的歷史文化，除了參觀博物館、工廠，還細味豆豉宴及買特產。有餐廳以漆器、風箏做裝飾，炮製出碌鵝等美食，體現對傳統文化的堅持。海陵島的日與夜同樣精彩，團隊登上懸崖泳池嬉水，沿濱海棧道細賞海岸風光；入夜後到珍珠白沙灘吃燒烤大餐，度過悠閒時光！

programme.title: 東坡家事#19粵PG
programme.desc: 大妹和季常在閏之的酒樓幫忙，月娥氣憤。皇上否決安石興建烽火台建議。東坡帶琴操到春釀坊做禡；席上蘇轍批評皇上，說話傳到皇上耳中被責廷杖調職。淑眉懷疑琴操告密，東坡極力維護。淑眉擔心史密聽到自己的秘密……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子從山田口中得知名為《惡鬼之子笑了》的故事，然後有天在公園遇到一名女孩，其後發生的事與故事情節雷同。小丸子被迫與山根一起成立「不虛度二月協會」，首個任務便是要訓練自己早起。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 從一份豐富早餐開展美好的一天，玲玲姐姐卻指平時自己吃一隻雞蛋已飽肚？子健哥哥提議可藉繪畫方式呈現，教大家畫出一份英式早餐，集齊多士、茄汁豆、沙律菜、香腸、番茄及飲品，就更添滿足。這集「開心SHARE」的主題是「我探索過的奇妙地方」，某小女孩曾目睹逾千隻企鵝齊齊「回家」的震撼場面。另有小朋友來稿描述出海深入岩洞的探險經歷，主持們都感同身受，還暢談各自出遊的難忘旅程，以及期待到訪的地方。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 在格林小姐幫助下，奈津找到場地舉行個人演唱會，小源一行都為她感到高興。然而就在這時，史納樂隊四人一同現身，並以萬全狀態向小源三人挑戰。面對史納樂隊的壓倒性合奏，公主合力也無法招架，終於初嘗敗績……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 貝沙灣一個1,500平方呎三房單位，設計師運用大量啞面原木，營造極簡風格，整體效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望之今夜愛回家粵 及 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2868粵
programme.desc: (大結局)熊家眾人離別在即，樹根一反常態暫停工作，也不下廚，經常坐在廳中追看劇集。尚善察覺不妥，為安全起見暗中安裝監控鏡頭。其後，尚善聯絡不上樹根，遂通知眾人。眾人翻看監控錄像片段，發現樹根接連發生家居意外，於是立刻趕回熊家，但途中各自遇到阻滯。回到家後，大家卻發現……最終，眾人作出重大決定。另一方面，尚善、力蓮分別自組公司，卻於同日同一時間開張，並都遇上阻滯……

programme.title: 全城開心．愛回家粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 長壽處境喜劇《愛．回家之開心速遞》，這夜迎來大結局。「根叔」劉丹與「大龍生」羅樂林帶領下，「大妹」滕麗名、「二妹」呂慧儀等「熊家人」，以及「大小姐」林淑敏、「三太」樊亦敏等「龍家人」，還有「接龍員工」齊集歡送派對。眾人屆時會將派送笑聲的「歡樂任務」，正式交棒！新劇《三代同糖》演員車婉婉、吳若希、李茵彤等亦現身接過這份光榮任務，跟現場觀眾同賀《開心速遞》圓滿謝幕，並延續「愛．回家」系列的溫情與歡笑。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#5粵
programme.desc: 雪文希望在中學籃球隊舊生聚會中令幸如出醜，幸如看穿雪文企圖。熙妍聯同婉蘭、林美淇為幸如重塑形象。幸如在餐廳重遇中學時期的暗戀對象陳浩恩，追問他當年態度突變的真相。同學聚會當晚，幸如拉着一直針對自己的三人組與雪文當面對質，並聯同浩恩，拆穿雪文過往種種謊言。幸如將繼威陷害家謙洩露公司機密的證據，交到家謙手中。最終，揭穿繼威陰謀時雖生變數，但家謙成功留在廣告公司，幸如則被調與一眾新結識的好姊妹成為組員！

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 當中樞神經受壓，引致一系列神經系統的症狀，會列入為「脊髓型頸椎病變」。醫生指此症風險將隨年紀增長而提升，惡化速度亦可以很快，並由上肢麻痺、行動不穩，再演變成癱瘓。職業治療師帶來一分鐘的快速測試方法，調查員秀怡的成績達標嗎？醫生建議患者越早開刀越好，手術縱屬高風險，但拖延只會令病情惡化；有哪些常見的手術治療？另外，政府中藥檢測中心會鑑別中藥真偽並確保品質，化驗師如何以DNA技術得出科學數據？

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#10粵普
programme.desc: 接待大客戶Marcos當天，蜜語錯漏百出，後來發現馮凱鑫給假資料。紀封逼走貪腐的賈大廚，提拔翹琪。貞貞搶到商務晚宴訂單，紀封臨陣任命翹琪。宴席海南雞飯被佔用，蜜語以陽春麵替代。晚宴獲好評，貞貞談合作未果…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
再創世紀#18粵
programme.desc: 定垚與子琳接待來自貴州的黎董，但對方態度冷淡。高哲刻意讓定垚見到天生與德輝會面，提醒她應該要培養自己人。定垚於是請建業幫忙，又得子琳協助，成功令黎董滿意。天生為投資風力發電而變賣天蔭中心，澤雨向啟堂提出換股以買回天蔭中心，遭對方拒絕。明晞替父海泉慶祝壽辰，夫婦二人卻遭海泉奚落。天蔭中心最終被外國天使基金收購，澤雨怒斥天生。定垚為澤雨引薦新加坡財團代表，澤雨為重振家業竟利用定垚，定垚向澤雨提出分手。

programme.title: 東張西望之今夜愛回家粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 東坡家事#20粵PG
programme.desc: 皇上要立琴操為妃，着她靜候佳音。農民丁東懷「流民圖」被奸官捉拿；安石發現畫作偽造。黎田指有乾女盼皇上立為妃，安石指乾女即琴操且身分有嫌疑。丁東乘有人劫獄逃走；東坡帶洪四和丁東之女丁丁從地道偷入皇宮……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#158粵
programme.desc: 悅要考輔警，高家為此分成支持與反對兩派。根提議以「兵捉賊」的遊戲來打賭，要悅扮警方，在二十四小時內捉拿由根扮成的恐佈分子，眾家人則配合雙方。追查過程中，悅處處碰璧，要家人多番提示才能繼續遊戲。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 完顏康騙包惜弱說穆家父女已走，郭靖取藥被大蛇襲擊，為保命吸光蛇血後，去救穆家父女得悉穆易是楊鐵心，包惜弱來放人卻沒認出眼前人。黃蓉偷聽完顏洪烈等人對話被發現，憑機智化解，包惜弱向完顏洪烈問起當年之事。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 中國史上第一個女皇帝武則天為求上位，不擇手段！嘉賓陶傑、游清源大讚她是謀朝篡位的人才！「歷史大誤解」解開江南第一風流才子唐伯虎的風流形象，了解他的真實生活狀況，唐解元還會交代「三笑姻緣」事件。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 武則天在高宗駕崩之後，有了第一男寵薛懷義，星級導師陶傑、游清源、王晶品評武后在私生活上的風流與角色需要。「大鑊密探凌凌一」發現某些成語故事，竟然存在詐騙成份！蘇軾大爆「卧薪嘗膽」的主角另有其人！

programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 我們，家(完)
programme.desc: 【金喜善陷入家庭危機！神秘女子揭露家族秘密】心理學博士兼知名人物英媛與家人過著幸福生活，直到神秘女子世娜的出現引發連鎖事件。公公意外身亡，丈夫在振與世娜失蹤，揭露他們的不倫關係。在尋找丈夫的過程中，英媛發現世娜是心理變態，曾殺死三個前夫。同時，兒子道賢也坦承與學校前輩素伊有了孩子。家庭的秘密逐漸浮出水面，英媛必須面對現實，守護家人並解開所有的謎團。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Confidence, Honesty, and Integrity - EP118

programme.title: Argo's World
programme.desc: Join Marie and Argo in this exciting STEM edutainment mixed-media series as they venture through Cyberspace and make discoveries about the world through historical figures and notable real-world personalities! Special guests include a founding father of the Internet, a NASA astronaut, a top robotics expert, and clever folks from M.I.T!

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Terror Tubes Takedown | Episode 7
programme.desc: The Gang dives headfirst into the Fear Zone - and it’s pure chaos. With Nightmare Mode activated and the Fear Bomb ticking, only faith can light the way.

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | The Breath of Courage | Episode 8
programme.desc: With 60 seconds left, the Fear Bomb ticks toward doom. Kungfuda and God's Gang fight with faith and love - will light prevail or fear win?

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Alien Mayhem! | Episode 1, 2, 3
programme.desc: God’s Gang faces insane challenges - from stopping a mad scientist to battling aliens and saving blue whales.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyson the Tanker refuels Jeremy
programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.desc: Graham is joined by Kylie Minogue, Stephen Graham, David Mitchell, Mawaan Rizwan. With music from Mae Muller, performing her single Me, Myself &amp; I.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee S09 - EP5
programme.desc: It's Week 5 and Art Week as the sewers take on modernist skirts, transform canvasses and make surrealist, made-to-measure dresses.

programme.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen S01 - EP3
programme.desc: Nisha Katona cooks a traditional monsoon mushroom curry with grapes, some tasty barbecued corn on the cob, and a cote de boeuf with the best spiced chilli rub.

programme.title: George Clarke's Remarkable Renovations S03 - Bakery, Lincolnshire
programme.desc: George Clarke meets Matt who is converting his Victorian bakery at the end of his garden into an accessible home for his sister Charlene and nephew Louis.

programme.title: DIY SOS S34 - EP2
programme.desc: In South Wales, Nick and the team take on the task of transforming the home of Dan and his partner Anna, after a freak accident shattered their dreams of moving in together. After nearly a year in hospital, and now a wheelchair user, Dan desperately needs his terraced house to become a place where he can focus on his rehabilitation and his goal of walking again. Despite the team's tireless efforts, the house stubbornly fights back at every turn, pushing everyone to the limit.

programme.title: Grand Designs S24 - Durham Dales
programme.desc: Artist Sarah returns to her roots in the Durham Dales to create a radical, cannabis-based house. But as costs go through the roof, can she get her hempcrete hub of a home over the line?

programme.title: Jamie: Eat Yourself Healthy S01 - EP4
programme.desc: Jamie celebrates heart-health promoting ingredients, as he makes a nutritious steak dinner and vibrant green orecchiette pasta, and whips up some gnarly gut-friendly oaty balls.

programme.title: Jason Atherton's Dubai Dishes S02 - EP5
programme.desc: Jason is on the beach in the coastal area of Jumeirah to delve into the ancient Arabic art of pickling while Ranvir Singh is treated to mutabbaq, a crispy Levant delight.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall S02 - EP8
programme.desc: On a visit to a dairy, Rick meets a man who is paid to eat 700 samples of cheese a week and cooks his sumptuous cheese and chive scones. His next stop is the salty old fishing town of Newlyn.

programme.title: Malaysia Gourmet With Justine Schofield S01 - EP8

programme.title: World's Most Luxurious S01 - Cars

Self-made millionaire Scott heads off to order a third Lamborghini from their range of luxury cars, while at a Porsche track day, owners get the chance to try out new models and put them to the test.

programme.title: Donal Skehan: Home Cook S01 - EP5
programme.desc: On today's menu, Moroccan spiced meatballs, a comforting chicken stew with dumplings and then, one my family loves, fish and clams with creamy spinach.

Next, Braised Pork and Aubergine, where Chinese Black Vinegar brings depth and richness to a heavenly combination.

programme.desc: There are leaves all over the place, Stanley tries to gather them up in his van with his leaf blower, but it is harder than he thought and fills Myrtle's house with them instead.

programme.desc: Its not all cats and dogs when it comes to pets. Our talking animals have their own, very silly favourites.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S02 - It's Time to Help at the Farm
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and Cousin Lexi visit the farm. They find out how the animals keep warm in winter and Gran Gran has a plan to help Lucy the lama keep cosy!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of 'fluffing' in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Days of the Week Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to learn that Mr Wobbly, the jelly juggler, is coming to town, and they can't wait to see him. But they become impatient, so Duggee makes sure to explain to them that the week will fly by and there's a lot to be done in that time. Duggee explains that a week is made up of seven days and what activities he does each day to stay busy. Each squirrel excitedly shares their usual plans between Monday and Friday so that they have something to look forward to while they wait f

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Same Badge
programme.desc: As Peggee and the Hummingbirds journey up the river to deliver a parcel, they have fun spotting and avoiding the wildlife that they meet along the way. All while Otti tries to avoid playing with the boat whistle! The Hummingbirds see the likes of meerkats, an aye-aye and snapping turtles and soon bump into some friendly faces - Duggee and the Squirrels! They are delivering a parcel upstream too.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Tarbela Dam, Pakistan
programme.desc: A G.O. Force is missing! The good news is that Jetpad has located it at the Tarbela Dam in Pakistan, but the bad news is that it's in the not so capable hands of Grandmaster Glitch. The Go Jetters speed off to get the click on back, but it's out of control -firing all kinds of weather, and Grandmaster Glitch doesn't know how to turn it off. As lightning strikes the Dam, threatening to flood the valley and hailstones flatten surrounding crops, the Go Jetters call for Click ons to defend the area

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Apple
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Apple. Singing in celebration of her great-great-grandad, Apple Tree's, 100th birthday.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Broccoli
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Broccoli and his floret, Broc, performing their phenomenal ventriloquist act.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Pea Repeats
programme.desc: Supertato is due to receive the Best Hero Award, but Evil Pea decides she should get it. Carrot tells her she needs to defeat herself to win the award.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Da Veggie Code
programme.desc: Supertato's Tato belt gets locked inside a glass case for an exhibition, but Tomato can't remember the code to get it out again, and Supertato needs it back to defeat Evil Pea.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Join In
programme.desc: The Teletubbies have their favourite things and The Noo­Noo wants to join in. When the Tubby Phone rings, the Teletubbies and The Noo­Noo do the Tubby Phone Dance together.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S07 - R
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'r', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We roar, dance like a robot and see a rainbow!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Spidermessy
programme.desc: Messy goes to OKIDO and helps his friends mend Loopy Bridge, but Zim finds himself in a sticky situation along the way!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Rock A Bye Bo
programme.desc: Bo is tired and falls asleep in the middle of hunting for Fabio's lost inflatable fruit. It's up to Mojo to finish the job - without waking up poor, exhausted Bo!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Petra, Jordan
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch goes on a desert adventure to uncover a mysterious lost city. If only it hadn't already been discovered! As Glitch attempts to beat a group of tourists to Petra in Jordan, he crashes his Grimbler in the Siq gorge. Vibrations from the Grimblers engines shake the surrounding area, causing the treasury building to shake apart. Can the Go Jetters save the ancient city?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Doctor
programme.desc: Honey is stuck waiting for Dr Bingo's as the other injuries get seen before her. Receptionist Bluey tells her to be patient, some of these cases are a real pickle!

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Escape
programme.desc: When Mum and Dad describe a made-up world where they can relax without the girls, Bluey and Bingo decide to burst into their fantasy and chase them down. How will Mum and Dad escape?

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.desc: Andy and Jen discover a meteorite crater on Dino Island. But a grumpy old Ankylosaurus charges through their camp.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the “speed gang”, led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the “speed gang” while on the island – can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father…

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from “Nine Yang Scriptures” by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancée, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the “Tsai Li Fu” style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed “The Invincible Fist” is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank &amp; returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Arcadia's Most Wanted
programme.desc: To stop the crime wave that has been hitting Arcadia, the Trollhunters must search for a missing Troll.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Bad Coffee
programme.desc: When Strickler tempts Jim to use dark magic in his training, it hits the school faculty in an unexpected way!

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Moving Day
programme.desc: After last season’s victory, Aja and Krel struggle to relocate Mothership back to their Arcadia Oaks neighborhood, but their task is complicated when Toby and Eli discover the Royals’ Akiridion secret.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Moonlight Run
programme.desc: Aja and Krel hitch a ride in Stuart’s old UFO on a mission to rescue Vex from a bounty hunter outpost on the Moon. Meanwhile, Zadra receives intel about Morando from a surprising new ally.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Dogfight Days of Summer
programme.desc: With Morando and his Armada heading for Earth, Aja and Krel clash with Vex and Zadra over how to handle the situation. Vex and Zadra want to alert human authorities, while the Royal teens seek out a more creative solution -- video games.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Battle Royal
programme.desc: Morgana takes a new title — Mother of Monsters — and vows to usher in an age of reckoning. An epic battle begins in King Arthur's court.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Killahead, Part One
programme.desc: Arthur seeks an alliance with the trolls of Dwoza as Gunmar begins building his army. Merlin and Douxie join forces to forge the amulet.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Struck Through The Heart Boov Up And Drive
programme.desc: Oh has an electric spark when he and Tip do the ultimate best friend handshake.Tip can't get Slushious back until she passes a Boovian Driver's Test.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Oh's Party Of Slumber Paranoid Activity
programme.desc: Oh throws a slumber party to take his friendship game to the next level with Tip's classmatesKyle will do whatever it takes to keep Oh accident-free.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Lights Camera Crackridge Karaoke Dokey
programme.desc: Archibald scores a job as a movie star's stunt double. Loy starts to lose it after getting a disappointing score on Archibald's karaoke video game.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Enchanted Mansion The Shell Game
programme.desc: While serving as Finly's magical assistant, Archibald gets lost in a spooky mansion. Archibald helps a grumpy hermit crab find a new shell.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Fashion Show
programme.desc: After attending a disappointing fashion show with Grandma, Olivia designs some fabulous clothes and is determined to put on her own show. Unfortunately, her models (Ian, Francine and Julian) prove to be more difficult to work with than she'd anticipated. It's up to Olivia to think fast and make the fashion show work!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Makes A Video
programme.desc: When Father takes an out-of-town business trip, Olivia doesn't want him to miss a thing. She decides to create a video diary, filming her family and classmates' everyday life, which isn't quite as exciting as she'd hoped. So Olivia adds her own touch to the final presentation: a big song and dance finish. Dad is thrilled.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Leads A Parade
programme.desc: As Mother tries to get baby William to sleep, Olivia, Ian and Julian create a backyard parade. When Francine finds out, she decides she's going to make her OWN parade. Olivia eventually sees that two parades can be better than one –and even figures out how to keep fussy William asleep.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Tends To The Sick
programme.desc: Julian comes down with a case of “itchyfootitis,” so it's Dr. Olivia to the rescue, with all kinds of silly treatments. When the “condition” begins to spread to others, Olivia imagines herself running an entire “itchy foot” clinic, and eventually discovers the perfect cure.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: It's time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Chore Score Dew Drop Swap
programme.desc: On Harper’s first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harper’s Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! programme.desc: Team Trollhunter discovers a surprising ally while trapped in a flooding tavern!
